name: Kimpton Charlotte Square
insider_take: Sophisticated Georgian elegance meets contemporary luxury in the heart of Edinburgh's prestigious New Town, where literary legends once roamed and royal charm still reigns.
whats_special: This boutique gem occupies seven magnificent Georgian townhouses on one of Edinburgh's most coveted garden squares. Charlotte Square was designed by renowned architect Robert Adam in the 1790s and is considered the finest example of Georgian architecture in Scotland. The hotel's location places you steps from the birthplace of the Edinburgh International Festival and within the UNESCO World Heritage Old and New Towns.
pro_tip: Book a room overlooking Charlotte Square's private gardens for stunning views of the Georgian architecture, and don't miss the hotel's evening wine hour - a signature Kimpton tradition that's perfect for mingling with fellow travelers.
dont_miss: Take a literary walking tour starting right from your doorstep - Charlotte Square hosts the annual Edinburgh International Book Festival. Visit the nearby Writers' Museum dedicated to Burns, Scott, and Stevenson, then stroll down the Royal Mile to Edinburgh Castle. The famous Princes Street shopping district is just a 2-minute walk away.
pros: Prime location on prestigious Charlotte Square in Edinburgh's New Town
Boutique luxury hotel with distinctive Kimpton design and personality
Georgian architecture seamlessly blended with contemporary amenities
Pet-friendly policy with complimentary pet amenities
cons: Limited parking availability in historic city center location
Premium pricing typical of luxury boutique properties
